intro: Convert US liquid gallons (gal) to liters (L) accurately for fuel tanks, aquariums, water jugs, and swimming pools. Each US gallon to liter conversion applies the exact NIST standard of 231 cubic inches, where 1 US gallon equals 3.78541178 liters (or litres in UK spelling). Multiply gallons by 3.78541 above, or look up common capacities from 0.5 to 1,700 gallons below.
alsoWrittenAs: gal to L, US gal to litres, gallons to litres, US liquid gallon to liter, gal into L

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Liquid Gallon (3.785 L) vs. UK Imperial Gallon (4.546 L) vs. US Dry Gallon
items: US liquid gallons and UK Imperial gallons share the same name but differ by 20.1%: 1 US gallon equals 3.78541 liters (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial gallon equals 4.54609 liters (160 Imp fl oz).
US dry gallons (4.40488 L, used historically for grain/produce) also differ from US liquid gallons; always confirm whether a fuel tank, recipe, or chemical spec uses US liquid or Imperial gallons.

faqs.question: How many liters are in 1 US gallon?
faqs.answer: There are 3.78541178 liters (about 3.78541 L) in 1 US liquid gallon. By comparison, 1 UK Imperial gallon equals 4.54609 liters.

faqs.question: How much is a half gallon of alcohol in liters?
faqs.answer: A half US gallon (0.5 gal) of alcohol or any liquid equals 1.89271 liters (about 1.89 L). Note that standard 1.75-liter 'handle' liquor bottles are slightly smaller at 0.462 US gallons, while 0.5 UK Imperial gallon equals 2.27305 liters.

faqs.question: How do I convert US gallons to liters?
faqs.answer: Multiply the volume in US gallons by 3.78541178 (L = gal × 3.78541178). For example, 45 gallons × 3.78541178 = 170.34353 liters.

faqs.question: What is 5 gallons in liters?
faqs.answer: 5 US gallons equals 18.92706 liters (rounds to 18.93 L).
